She was created by Wes Craven.  The character was portrayed by Amanda Wyss in the original film and Katie Cassidy in the 2010 film.  A high school student whose death is the catalyst for the events of the series, Gray is the false protagonist of the 1984 original film.  She also appears in the novels, "Wes Craven's New Nightmare" (1994), "Freddy vs. Jason" (2003), 2010 reboot, merchandise based on the films, and a claymation version of the character is shown in the documentary "" (2010).
